title: 第13章  连闯九楼，击杀苏晨！
content_zh:
青阳郡。
武楼外。
所有人看着石碑顶部，那个金光璀璨的名字，全都沉默了。
他们，竟然亲眼见证了奇迹。
方玄，竟然连闯九楼，武楼登顶。
纵观武楼建立上万年以来，能够武楼登顶之人，不超百人。
而这些人，无一例外，都成为了名震一方的顶尖强者。
整个青阳郡，甚至整个青州地界，能够做到这一步的人，唯有方玄。
方玄二字，高居石碑顶端，碾压下方一众人名。
如君临天下。
石碑前。
众人沉默。
方雨容失神。
李天骄微张红唇，难以掩饰自己的震惊。
苏晨，缓缓瘫软在地，面如死灰。
他败了。
败得彻彻底底。
方玄登上六楼，已经足够出人意料。
登上七楼，颠覆所有人的认知。
登上八楼，创造奇迹。

通关九楼，这是凡人根本无法做到的事情。
这是神迹！
“哒！”
“哒！”
“哒！”
脚步声响起，如同踩在所有人的心脏上，令他们窒息，令他们战栗。
少年一袭白衣，身姿如玉。
他迈步而来，所有人下意识的让开道路。
来到苏晨面前，方玄站定。
“苏晨，你输了。”
少年脸庞稍显稚嫩，但已然初具强者威势。
他目光环扫，无人敢与之对视，尽皆低下头去。
包括方雨容，也被方玄身上的气势所震慑，下意识的后退一步。
“败？那又如何！”
苏晨惨笑一声，随即放声大笑。
他看着方玄，脸色狰狞道：“方玄，即便我败了，你敢杀我吗？敢吗！”
不少人眉头微皱。
觉得苏晨有些输不起。
“我苏家，乃是青阳郡三大家族之一。”
苏晨语气低沉道：“我苏家苏清瑶，如今乃是问道宗弟子，和问道宗天骄赵擎苍，情投意合，你敢杀我吗？”

“杀了我，就是得罪了整个问道宗！”
苏晨盯着方玄，一字一句道：“你方家，承受不起这个后果。你方玄，更承受不起！”
此话一出，众人恍然。
他们这才想起，苏家已经今非昔比。
不说苏家本身的实力底蕴。
一个拜入问道宗的苏清瑶，就像是一座大山，足以压得整个方家，无法喘息。
“我不敢杀你？”
方玄嗤笑一声，如同听到最好笑的笑话。
“苏晨，你高看了你苏家，高看了苏清瑶，更高看了问道宗！”
少年语气平静，却掷地有声。
“苏清瑶欺我骗我，废我武脉，毁我丹田，断我修行路。”
“赵擎苍，夺我道体，令我九死一生。”
“此仇，就从你苏家开始清算！”
一石激起千层浪。
方玄的话，让所有人面露震撼，难以置信。
方玄侵犯苏清瑶是假的？
实际上，是苏清瑶欺骗方玄，废他的武脉丹田。
是赵擎苍要强夺方玄的先天道体？
这怎么可能？
这一刻，连李天骄都被震惊到了。

而方雨容，则是面色惨白，眼中满是惊恐。
“方玄，这等大逆不道之语，你休要胡说！”
不是她不相信方玄。
而是这话，若是传到问道宗那里，绝对会为方家带来灭族之祸。
“方玄，你简直疯了！”
苏晨也冷笑道：“冒犯我妹妹苏清瑶不说，还敢颠倒黑白，诬陷问道宗弟子，你方玄当诛，你方家当灭！”
“我方玄当不当诛，我不知道。”
方玄语气淡漠的说道：“但你苏晨，今天却是要死了。”
说罢，方玄抬脚，猛然踹向苏晨的脑袋。
“方玄，你敢！”
苏晨手掌拍地，险之又险的避开方玄这一脚。
“你杀了我，苏家绝对不会放过你的！”
方玄冷笑：“从你羞辱我妹妹那一刻开始，我就没打算放过你！”
话音落下，方玄身若龙鱼，瞬间出现在苏晨面前。
五指紧握，一拳轰向苏晨胸膛。
危急关头，苏晨双手架起，准备阻挡方玄这一拳。
在他看来，方玄即便连闯九楼，武楼登顶，也杀不了自己。
他可是炼体境武者！
但是在方玄拳头触及他双臂的时候，苏晨意识到，自己错了。
而且错得离谱。

“咔嚓！”
狂暴的力量，从方玄拳头上爆涌而出，直接将苏晨的双臂砸碎，将他轰飞出去，大口咳血。
怎么可能！
连见到这一幕的众人，都不由得倒吸一口凉气。
苏晨再如何，好歹也是炼体境武者。
而方玄，充其量只是造血境修为。
他竟然一击，就击败了苏晨。
越级而战！
还占据上方，这简直太不可思议了。
“方玄，你......”
苏晨满脸惊恐，难以置信的看着方玄。
但方玄没有半句废话，继续出拳，砸向苏晨。
拥有武道极境的他，对付一个刚突破炼体境的苏晨，易如反掌。
苏晨知道，他根本接不住方玄这第二拳。
“小畜生，你给我住手！”
就在此时，一道暴怒声由远及近传来。
就见到，一名中年人，以极快的速度奔赴而来，要阻止方玄。
来人，正是苏家二爷。
苏崇山。
也是苏晨的父亲。

“父亲救我！”
苏崇山的出现，对苏晨来说，宛如救星，连忙开口呼救。
“今天就算是神仙来了，也救不了你！”
方玄眼神冷冽，速度更快三分。
“死！”
龙鱼身法施展，一步跨到苏晨面前，拳罡绽放，精准至极的轰击在苏晨的胸膛之上。
“噗！”
苏晨胸膛凹陷，余力从背部冲出。
而他本人，更是被一拳轰飞出数米，刚好跌落到苏崇山的怀中，当场没了气息。
“儿啊！”
抱着苏晨的尸体，苏崇山声音凄厉。
“小畜生，你胆敢杀我儿，我要将你碎尸万段！”
儿子被杀，苏崇山双目赤红，聚气境的修为，彻底释放而出。
下一刻，苏崇山直接扑向方玄，一掌朝着方玄脑袋拍了下去。
“方玄，快走！”
眼见苏崇山对方玄出手，方雨容惊呼一声，修为流转，正要出手阻拦。
但另外一道身影，比她更快。
“嘭嘭！”
绿色身影，挡在方玄面前，连出两掌，将苏崇山的攻势接住。
但也因此连续后退，体内元气翻滚。

竟然是李天骄！
“方玄哥哥，你先走。”
李天骄头也不回的说道：“我替你拦着这家伙。”
见到李天骄竟然为方玄出头，而且称之为哥哥，即便场合不对，不少人也是心碎了一地。
难道，李天骄心仪方玄？
方雨容更是如同见鬼一般。
三大家族向来不和，方家和李家更是敌对关系，比与之前的苏家，关系还要恶劣。
何时方玄和李天骄的关系这么好了？
“李天骄！”
苏崇山面皮抖动，怒声道：“我儿本倾慕于你，你不帮他报仇也就罢了，还要维护这个小杂碎？”
“苏崇山，你脑袋被驴踢了吧？”
李天骄说道：“苏晨倾慕我，我就要为他报仇？你脑袋里装的都是狗屎吗？”
“你......”
被一个小辈当着这么多人的面呵斥，苏崇山差点被气得吐血。
“你什么你？”
李天骄直接打断苏崇山：“苏晨和方玄哥哥之间的赌约，乃是众人亲眼见证，武楼也是允许了的，他死了也是活该，你若敢以大欺小，对方玄哥哥出手，是不将武楼放在眼里吗？”
闻言，众人脸色一阵古怪。
这李天骄，为了方玄，竟然不惜当众训斥苏崇山。
这胆子，可真是不小啊。
“伶牙俐齿的臭丫头！”

苏崇山满腔怒火快要喷薄而出，厉声道：“胆敢出言无状，今日我就要替你家长辈，好好教训教训你！”
“我李山崖的孙女，何时轮得到你苏崇山来教训了？”
苍老的声音蓦地响起。
紧接着，一道身影从天而降，重重落在苏崇山面前，周身气息狂烈。
极度爆炸的出场方式，震得地面颤抖。
不少人更是直接栽倒在地。
李家家主，李山崖！
一名修为达到凝元境的强者。
“爷爷！”
见到李山崖出现，李天骄小嘴一瘪，抓住李山崖的衣袖晃了晃，满脸委屈。
“您要是再晚来一步，就见不到你乖巧可爱的孙女了，呜呜呜。”
李山崖闻言，顿时心疼坏了。
“乖孙女别怕。”
李山崖脸色一变，轻声细语的说道：“有爷爷在，我看谁敢动你一指头！”
猛的，李山崖看向苏崇山。
“小崽子，你要杀我孙女？你好大的狗胆！”
凝元境的气息释放，直接将苏崇山震退数步。
闻言，众人顿时面皮抽动。
都说李山崖最是护短，对李天骄这个孙女，可谓是捧在手里怕掉了，含在嘴里怕化了，宠溺到骨子里。
今日一见，还真是比传言还要可怕。

“李老家主，这是个误会。”
苏崇山连连摆手。
“此事起因乃是方玄杀我儿子，你孙女无端阻拦，我只是......”
“闭嘴！”
不等苏崇山把话说完，李山崖顿时冷喝一声。
“我孙女向来最明事理，何来无端阻拦？定是你这小崽子，自己儿子死了，嫉妒我有这么可爱的孙女，所以才要下手加害，你好歹毒的心思！”
“噗！”
本就怒火攻心的苏崇山，这一次真的被气得吐血。
“李老家主，你当真要如此不讲理吗？”
苏崇山一字一句道：“还是说，你真以为，我苏家怕了你李家？”
content_en:
Qingyang County.
Outside the Wu Building.
Everyone looked at the shining golden name on the top of the stone tablet and fell silent.
They actually witnessed the miracle with their own eyes.
Fang Xuan actually broke through the ninth floor and reached the top of Wu Tower.
Throughout the tens of thousands of years since the Martial Tower was established, there have been no more than a hundred people who have been able to reach the top of the Martial Tower.
And these people, without exception, have become famous and top experts.
In the entire Qingyang County, and even in the entire Qingzhou territory, the only person who could do this was Fang Xuan.
The word "Fang Xuan" stands high on the top of the stone tablet, crushing the names of people below.
Like a king over the world.
In front of the stone monument.
Everyone was silent.
Fang Yurong lost his mind.
Li Tianjiao opened his red lips slightly, unable to conceal his shock.
Su Chen slowly collapsed to the ground, his face ashen.
He lost.
Complete defeat.
Fang Xuan ascended to the sixth floor, which was surprising enough.
Climb to the seventh floor and subvert everyone's perceptions.
Climb to the eighth floor and create a miracle.
Clearing the ninth floor is something that a mere mortal cannot do.
This is a miracle!
"Da!"
"Da!"
"Da!"
The sound of footsteps sounded like stepping on everyone's heart, suffocating them and making them tremble.
The young man is dressed in white and has a jade-like figure.
He stepped forward, and everyone subconsciously moved out of the way.
Arriving in front of Su Chen, Fang Xuan stood still.
"Su Chen, you lose."
The young man's face is a little childish, but he is already beginning to take on the power of a strong man.
He glanced around, no one dared to look at him, they all lowered their heads.
Including Fang Yurong, who was also shocked by Fang Xuan's aura and subconsciously took a step back.
"Defeat? So what!"
Su Chen laughed miserably, then laughed loudly.
He looked at Fang Xuan and said with a ferocious expression: "Fang Xuan, even if I lose, do you dare to kill me? Dare you!"
Many people frowned slightly.
I felt that Su Chen couldn't afford to lose.
"My Su family is one of the three major families in Qingyang County."
Su Chen said in a low tone: "I, Su Qingyao of the Su family, am now a disciple of the Taoist Sect, and I am in love with Zhao Qingcang, the genius of the Taoist Sect. Do you dare to kill me?"
"Killing me will offend the entire Taoist sect!"
Su Chen stared at Fang Xuan and said word by word: "Your Fang family cannot bear the consequences. You Fang Xuan cannot bear it even more!"
As soon as these words came out, everyone was stunned.
Only then did they remember that the Su family was no longer what it used to be.
Not to mention the strength of the Su family itself.
Su Qingyao, who joined the Taoist sect, was like a big mountain, enough to crush the entire Fang family, unable to breathe.
"I dare not kill you?"
Fang Xuan sneered, as if he had heard the funniest joke.
"Su Chen, you think highly of your Su family, you think highly of Su Qingyao, and you think highly of Taoism!"
The young man's tone was calm but loud.
"Su Qingyao deceived me, destroyed my martial arts, destroyed my Dantian, and cut off my path of cultivation."
"Zhao Qingcang, take away my Taoist body and make me narrowly escape death."
"This feud will begin with your Su family!"
One stone stirs up a thousand waves.
Fang Xuan's words made everyone look shocked and unbelievable.
Is it false that Fang Xuan violated Su Qingyao?
In fact, it was Su Qingyao who deceived Fang Xuan and destroyed his martial arts dantian.
Is it Zhao Qingcang who wants to seize Fang Xuan's innate Taoist body?
How is this possible?
At this moment, even Li Tianjiao was shocked.
As for Fang Yurong, her face was pale and her eyes were filled with fear.
"Fang Xuan, don't talk nonsense like this!"
It's not that she doesn't believe Fang Xuan.
But if these words reach Taoist Sect, they will definitely bring disaster to the Fang family.
"Fang Xuan, you are simply crazy!"
Su Chen also sneered: "Not only did you offend my sister Su Qingyao, but you dared to confuse right and wrong and falsely accuse Dao Sect disciples, you Fang Xuan should be punished, and your Fang family should be destroyed!"
"I don't know if Fang Xuandang should be executed."
Fang Xuan said indifferently: "But you, Su Chen, are going to die today."
After saying that, Fang Xuan raised his foot and kicked Su Chen on the head."Fang Xuan, how dare you!"
Su Chen slapped the ground with his palm, narrowly avoiding Fang Xuan's kick.
"If you kill me, the Su family will never let you go!"
Fang Xuan sneered: "From the moment you humiliated my sister, I had no intention of letting you go!"
As soon as the words fell, Fang Xuan appeared in front of Su Chen in an instant like a dragon and fish.
He clenched his fingers tightly and punched Su Chen in the chest.
At the critical moment, Su Chen raised his hands, preparing to block Fang Xuan's punch.
In his opinion, even if Fang Xuan broke through the ninth floor and climbed to the top of the martial arts tower, he still couldn't kill him.
He is a body refining realm warrior!
But when Fang Xuan's fist touched his arms, Su Chen realized that he was wrong.
And it couldn't be more wrong.
"Crack!"
Violent power burst out from Fang Xuan's fist, directly smashing Su Chen's arms into pieces and sending him flying away, causing him to cough up blood.
How is that possible!
Even everyone who saw this scene couldn't help but take a breath.
No matter what, Su Chen was still a body refining realm warrior.
As for Fang Xuan, he is only at the blood-making realm at best.
He actually defeated Su Chen with one blow.
Fight beyond the level!
It's incredible that it still occupies the top.
"Fang Xuan, you..."
Su Chen's face was full of horror and he looked at Fang Xuan in disbelief.
But Fang Xuan didn't say anything nonsense and continued to punch Su Chen.
He possesses the ultimate level of martial arts, and it is easy for him to deal with Su Chen, who has just broken through to the body refining level.
Su Chen knew that he couldn't catch Fang Xuan's second punch.
"Little beast, stop it!"
At this moment, a violent sound came from far and near.
Then he saw a middle-aged man rushing towards him at extremely fast speed to stop Fang Xuan.
The person who came was none other than the second master of the Su family.
Su Chongshan.
He is also Su Chen’s father.
"Father, save me!"
The appearance of Su Chongshan was like a savior to Su Chen, and he quickly called for help.
"Even if a god comes today, he can't save you!"
Fang Xuan's eyes were cold and he was three points faster.
"Death!"
Using the dragon fish movement technique, he stepped in front of Su Chen, his fists bloomed, and struck Su Chen's chest with extreme precision.
"Poof!"
Su Chen's chest was sunken, and the remaining energy rushed out from his back.
As for him, he was sent flying several meters by the punch and just fell into Su Chongshan's arms, losing his breath on the spot.
"Son!"
Holding Su Chen's body, Su Chongshan's voice was shrill.
"Little beast, if you dare to kill my son, I will cut you into pieces!"
His son was killed, Su Chongshan's eyes turned red, and his Qi Gathering Realm cultivation was completely released.
The next moment, Su Chongshan pounced directly on Fang Xuan and slapped Fang Xuan on the head.
"Fang Xuan, leave quickly!"
Seeing Su Chongshan take action against Fang Xuan, Fang Yurong exclaimed, her cultivation level was changing, and she was about to take action to stop him.
But another figure was faster than her.
"Bang bang!"
The green figure stood in front of Fang Xuan and used two palms to catch Su Chongshan's attack.
But because of this, he continued to retreat, and the vitality in his body was tumbling.
It turned out to be Li Tianjiao!
"Brother Fang Xuan, you go first."
Li Tianjiao said without looking back: "I'll stop this guy for you."
Many people were heartbroken when they saw Li Tianjiao standing up for Fang Xuan and calling him brother, even if the situation was wrong.
Could it be that Li Tianjiao has a crush on Fang Xuan?
Fang Yurong felt as if he had seen a ghost.
The three major families have always been at odds, and the Fang family and the Li family have an even more hostile relationship, which is even worse than the previous relationship with the Su family.
When did the relationship between Fang Xuan and Li Tianjiao become so good?
"Li Tianjiao!"
Su Chongshan's face trembled and he said angrily: "My son loves you. It's fine if you don't help him get revenge. Are you going to defend this little bastard?"
"Su Chongshan, was your head kicked by a donkey?"
Li Tianjiao said: "Su Chen admires me, so I want to avenge him? Are all the bullshit in your head?"
"You..."
Being watched by a juniorSu Chongshan was so angry that he almost vomited blood after being scolded in front of so many people.
"What are you?"
Li Tianjiao directly interrupted Su Chongshan: "The bet between Su Chen and Brother Fang Xuan was witnessed by everyone with their own eyes. Wu Lou also agreed to it. He deserves to die. If you dare to bully the younger brother with a big one, and take action against Brother Fang Xuan, don't you take Wu Lou seriously?"
Hearing this, everyone looked strange.
This Li Tianjiao, for Fang Xuan's sake, even scolded Su Chongshan in public.
This courage is really not small.
"Sharp-tongued stinky girl!"
Su Chongshan was filled with anger and was about to burst out, and said sternly: "If you dare to speak out, I will take care of you today and teach you a lesson!"
"I, the granddaughter of Li Shanya, when will it be your turn, Su Chongshan, to teach me a lesson?"
An old voice suddenly sounded.
Immediately afterwards, a figure descended from the sky and landed heavily in front of Su Chongshan, with a fierce aura around him.
The extremely explosive appearance made the ground tremble.
Many people fell directly to the ground.
The head of the Li family, Li Shanya!
A strong man whose cultivation has reached the Condensing Yuan Realm.
"Grandpa!"
Seeing Li Shanya appear, Li Tianjiao pursed his lips, grabbed Li Shanya's sleeve and shook it, his face full of grievance.
"If you were a step later, you wouldn't be able to see your cute and well-behaved granddaughter, woo woo woo."
When Li Shanya heard this, he felt heartbroken.
"Don't be afraid, dear granddaughter."
Li Shanya's expression changed and he whispered softly: "As long as grandpa is here, let's see who dares to lay a finger on you!"
Fiercely, Li Shanya looked at Su Chongshan.
"Baby, you want to kill my granddaughter? You are so brave!"
The aura of the Condensing Yuan Realm was released, directly knocking Su Chongshan back several steps.
Hearing this, everyone's faces suddenly twitched.
It is said that Li Shanya is the most protective of his shortcomings. For Li Tianjiao, his granddaughter, he holds it in his hand for fear of dropping it and holds it in his mouth for fear of it melting. He dotes on his granddaughter to the core.
When I saw it today, it was really scarier than the rumors.
"Master Li, this is a misunderstanding."
Su Chongshan waved his hands repeatedly.
"The cause of this incident is that Fang Xuan killed my son. Your granddaughter stopped her without any reason. I just..."
"Shut up!"
Before Su Chongshan could finish speaking, Li Shanya gave a cold shout.
"My granddaughter has always been the most sensible, why did she stop her for no reason? It must be you, little brat. Your own son is dead. You are jealous that I have such a lovely granddaughter, so you want to harm me. You are so vicious!"
"Poof!"
Su Chongshan, who was already so angry, was so angry that he vomited blood this time.
"Master Li, do you really want to be so unreasonable?"
Su Chongshan said word by word: "Or do you really think that my Su family is afraid of your Li family?"
